interpretation: A low booking/reference ratio can trigger a field check only after all evidence gates pass; it does not estimate unreported demand or prove under-service.
limits: E2 Census values are approximate (2009 to 2016 ward crosswalk); they are accepted for field checks only, never as exact-geometry validation.
HMWSSB tanker observations are monthly section totals; no verified section-to-ward transfer exists.
Census household and need covariates are historical and provisional for unvalidated locations.
E3 building trends are stable after removing city-wide year shocks; growth is context only and not used for ranking.
No field-check labels exist, so empirical precision/recall and real-world accuracy are unavailable.
This screen cannot identify who did not report or infer reporting propensity from counts alone.
A candidate means 'send someone to check'; it never changes allocation, eligibility, or entitlement.
